description: This file defines the 'perf_mysql' class, which provides performance monitoring, reporting, and optimization methods for MySQL databases within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer. It includes SQL scripts for logging, retrieving table status, cache ratios, and execution metrics, as well as methods to explain queries, fetch performance data, and optimize tables.

classes.name: perf_mysql
classes.description: A class extending adodb_perf that provides performance monitoring and tuning functionalities specifically for MySQL, including methods to retrieve cache ratios, table status, query explanations, and to optimize tables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the perf_mysql instance with a database connection.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Provides an EXPLAIN plan for a SELECT SQL query, aiding in query performance analysis.

methods.name: tables
methods.description: Returns an HTML formatted table status report.

methods.name: GetReads
methods.description: Returns the number of SELECT queries executed, as fetched from MySQL status.

methods.name: GetWrites
methods.description: Returns the number of data modification queries (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) executed.

methods.name: FindDBHitRatio
methods.description: Determines the cache hit ratio for the database, identifying the table type and related cache performance.

methods.name: GetQHitRatio
methods.description: Calculates the query cache hit ratio based on MySQL status variables.

methods.name: GetInnoDBHitRatio
methods.description: Retrieves and calculates the InnoDB buffer pool hit ratio from InnoDB status output.

methods.name: GetKeyHitRatio
methods.description: Calculates the index key cache hit ratio for MySQL.

methods.name: optimizeTable
methods.description: Performs table optimization with a specified mode (low or high).
